httpEnabled.title: Enable Streamable HTTP server
httpEnabled.description: Serve MCP over HTTP at http://<address>:<port>/mcp, in addition to stdio. Off by default.

httpHost.title: Bind address
httpHost.description: 127.0.0.1 accepts local connections only. 0.0.0.0 accepts connections from your network.

httpManageProcess.title: Start and stop the server from Super Productivity
httpManageProcess.description: On: enabling the server here launches it (and stops it when disabled); use the buttons in the plugin's page (the 'MCP HTTP server' panel) to restart it. Off: you run 'super-productivity-mcp --http' yourself, e.g. in a container or on another machine, and it follows these settings.

httpRequireToken.title: Require bearer token
httpRequireToken.description: Clients must send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Not required by default, but it is best practice — strongly recommended whenever the bind address is anything other than 127.0.0.1. The token is generated for you and kept on this device only (never synced); view, copy or replace it in the plugin's 'MCP HTTP server' panel.

httpAllowedHosts.title: Allowed hosts
httpAllowedHosts.description: Accepted values of the request's Host header, separated by commas or spaces. Example: console.example.org, 10.0.0.5:8765. A name without a port matches any port. Set this when binding to anything other than 127.0.0.1; localhost names are always accepted on a local bind.

httpAllowedOrigins.title: Allowed origins
httpAllowedOrigins.description: Browser pages allowed to call the server, as full origins separated by commas or spaces. Example: http://console.example.org. On a local (127.0.0.1) bind this is optional and pages served from localhost are always accepted; on any other bind, requests carrying an Origin header that is not listed are refused. Clients that are not browsers send no Origin and are unaffected.
